definition: A follicular dendritic cell of the germinal center, distinguished at the transcriptomic level by expression of COL27A1, encoding the alpha-1 chain of type XXVII fibrillar collagen (PMID:35186112). Like all follicular dendritic cells, it is non-hematopoietic, mesenchymally derived from perivascular precursors, and bears Fc and complement receptors including CR2 (PMID:33912182). It contributes to germinal center formation by secreting CXCL13 to direct B cell chemotaxis and by retaining antigen as immune complexes on its surface (PMID:24863064; PMID:32424359). COL27A1 is a transcriptomically-defined discriminating marker of this subset; protein-level validation in tonsil follicular dendritic cells has not been reported. Follicular dendritic cells populate the germinal centers of secondary lymphoid organs generally.

logical_axioms.notes: Resides within the germinal center of secondary lymphoid organs (broad ASTA search: not tonsil-restricted); the source atlas sampled human palatine tonsil.
FDCs of this type participate in organizing the germinal center light zone and dark zone, contributing to but not solely carrying out germinal center formation (Pikor et al. 2020, PMID:32424359).
FDCs secrete CXCL13, which drives B cell chemotaxis into and within the follicle (Jarjour et al. 2014, PMID:24863064). The cell contributes to but does not solely execute B cell chemotaxis.

CR2 (CD21) is a canonical FDC surface marker reported at the protein level for FDCs in germinal centers (Anania et al. 2021, PMID:33912182). This axiom is based on class-level protein evidence for FDCs generally; PR:P20023 is the human-specific form.

synonyms.value: follicular dendritic cell of tonsil germinal center

references.supports: Upstream tonsil single-cell study used as a starting annotation by the reference atlas.
FDC subset heterogeneity (LZ/DZ), germinal center reorganization, CXCL13 expression; supports 'capable of part of' germinal center formation axiom
FDC origin from perivascular precursors, CXCL13 secretion, antigen retention as immune complexes; supports functional axioms and definition
Complement receptors CR1/CR2 as canonical FDC surface markers; supports CR2 plasma membrane axiom
COL27A1 gene product description as type XXVII fibrillar collagen alpha-1 chain; supports definition of discriminating transcript marker
FDC subset classification, CR2/FCGR2B/FCER2A marker expression across LZ and DZ FDC subsets
LZ- and DZ-FDC subset identity in germinal centers; context for zonal FDC heterogeneity
Azimuth human_tonsil_v2 single-cell reference atlas (source of the cell-type annotation).

justification: CL:0000442 (follicular dendritic cell) is a broad parent covering all FDCs in lymphoid follicles and germinal centers. The atlas cluster FDC_COL27A1 is a transcriptomically defined subset that is distinguished by high expression of COL27A1 (type XXVII collagen alpha-1 chain) and is specifically localized to the human palatine tonsil germinal center. No CL term exists for (1) a COL27A1-expressing FDC subset, (2) a germinal-center-specific FDC, or (3) any FDC zonal subtype (light-zone or dark-zone FDC). The new term is needed to represent this molecularly and anatomically defined FDC subset. A broader set of NTRs for light-zone and dark-zone FDC subtypes would also be biologically justified. Evidence caveat: COL27A1 is an atlas transcript-level marker only; no protein-level or functional validation of COL27A1 in FDCs has been reported in the traversed literature. The CR2 plasma membrane axiom is based on class-level protein evidence for FDCs generally, not specifically for this COL27A1+ subset. [Revised 2026-07-28: de-anchored from palatine tonsil. A broad ASTA tissue-distribution search established this is a general population of secondary lymphoid organs / MALT rather than a palatine-tonsil-specific type; the tonsil is merely the tissue sampled by the atlas. Label and location axiom generalised accordingly (location → germinal center, UBERON:0010754). [Revised 2026-07-28: species-neutral term — marker axioms standardised to generic (cross-species) PR classes per CL convention; marker species attribution retained in the definition text. (PR:P20023->PR:000001338).]

## New term request: COL27A1-positive follicular dendritic cell

**Proposed label:** COL27A1-positive follicular dendritic cell

**Definition:** A follicular dendritic cell of the germinal center, distinguished at the transcriptomic level by expression of COL27A1, encoding the alpha-1 chain of type XXVII fibrillar collagen (PMID:35186112). Like all follicular dendritic cells, it is non-hematopoietic, mesenchymally derived from perivascular precursors, and bears Fc and complement receptors including CR2 (PMID:33912182). It contributes to germinal center formation by secreting CXCL13 to direct B cell chemotaxis and by retaining antigen as immune complexes on its surface (PMID:24863064; PMID:32424359). COL27A1 is a transcriptomically-defined discriminating marker of this subset; protein-level validation in tonsil follicular dendritic cells has not been reported. Follicular dendritic cells populate the germinal centers of secondary lymphoid organs generally.

**Parent (is_a):** follicular dendritic cell (CL:0000442)

**Anatomical location:** germinal center (UBERON:0010754)

**Logical axioms:**
- `part of` (BFO:0000050) some **germinal center** (UBERON:0010754) — Resides within the germinal center of secondary lymphoid organs (broad ASTA search: not tonsil-restricted); the source atlas sampled human palatine tonsil.
- `capable of part of` (RO:0002216) some **germinal center formation** (GO:0002467) — FDCs of this type participate in organizing the germinal center light zone and dark zone, contributing to but not solely carrying out germinal center formation (Pikor et al. 2020, PMID:32424359).
- `capable of part of` (RO:0002216) some **B cell chemotaxis** (GO:0035754) — FDCs secrete CXCL13, which drives B cell chemotaxis into and within the follicle (Jarjour et al. 2014, PMID:24863064). The cell contributes to but does not solely execute B cell chemotaxis.
- `has plasma membrane part` (RO:0002104) some **complement receptor type 2** (PR:000001338) — CR2 (CD21) is a canonical FDC surface marker reported at the protein level for FDCs in germinal centers (Anania et al. 2021, PMID:33912182). This axiom is based on class-level protein evidence for FDCs generally; PR:P20023 is the human-specific form.

**Synonyms:**
- COL27A1+ FDC (exact)
- COL27A1-expressing follicular dendritic cell (exact)
- follicular dendritic cell of tonsil germinal center (broad)

**References:**
- King et al. (2021). DOI: 10.1126/sciimmunol.abh3768 ; PMID:34623901 — Atlas source: Azimuth human tonsil v2; defines COL27A1+ as a discriminating FDC subset label
- Pikor et al. (2020). DOI: 10.1038/s41590-020-0672-y ; PMID:32424359 — FDC subset heterogeneity (LZ/DZ), germinal center reorganization, CXCL13 expression; supports 'capable of part of' germinal center formation axiom
- Jarjour et al. (2014). DOI: 10.1084/jem.20132409 ; PMID:24863064 — FDC origin from perivascular precursors, CXCL13 secretion, antigen retention as immune complexes; supports functional axioms and definition
- Anania et al. (2021). DOI: 10.3389/fimmu.2021.655753 ; PMID:33912182 — Complement receptors CR1/CR2 as canonical FDC surface markers; supports CR2 plasma membrane axiom
- Hu et al. (2022). DOI: 10.1155/2022/2616827 ; PMID:35186112 — COL27A1 gene product description as type XXVII fibrillar collagen alpha-1 chain; supports definition of discriminating transcript marker
- Lütge et al. (2021). DOI: 10.1111/imr.12981 ; PMID:34046914 — FDC subset classification, CR2/FCGR2B/FCER2A marker expression across LZ and DZ FDC subsets
- Onder et al. (2021). DOI: 10.1111/imr.13051 ; PMID:34866192 — LZ- and DZ-FDC subset identity in germinal centers; context for zonal FDC heterogeneity

**Justification:** CL:0000442 (follicular dendritic cell) is a broad parent covering all FDCs in lymphoid follicles and germinal centers. The atlas cluster FDC_COL27A1 is a transcriptomically defined subset that is distinguished by high expression of COL27A1 (type XXVII collagen alpha-1 chain) and is specifically localized to the human palatine tonsil germinal center. No CL term exists for (1) a COL27A1-expressing FDC subset, (2) a germinal-center-specific FDC, or (3) any FDC zonal subtype (light-zone or dark-zone FDC). The new term is needed to represent this molecularly and anatomically defined FDC subset. A broader set of NTRs for light-zone and dark-zone FDC subtypes would also be biologically justified. Evidence caveat: COL27A1 is an atlas transcript-level marker only; no protein-level or functional validation of COL27A1 in FDCs has been reported in the traversed literature. The CR2 plasma membrane axiom is based on class-level protein evidence for FDCs generally, not specifically for this COL27A1+ subset. [Revised 2026-07-28: de-anchored from palatine tonsil. A broad ASTA tissue-distribution search established this is a general population of secondary lymphoid organs / MALT rather than a palatine-tonsil-specific type; the tonsil is merely the tissue sampled by the atlas. Label and location axiom generalised accordingly (location → germinal center, UBERON:0010754). [Revised 2026-07-28: species-neutral term — marker axioms standardised to generic (cross-species) PR classes per CL convention; marker species attribution retained in the definition text. (PR:P20023->PR:000001338).]
